text:
elaine: Heads up — Flightdeck dashboard shows webinar -> demo lead conversion down 28% WoW. SFDC pipeline looks higher than GA conversions. Anyone else seeing a mismatch?

analytics-bot: Quick summary posted: https://redwood-insights/reports/22345. Initial findings: 24% of leads missing UTM tags, sample_rate flag changed on landing. Ran a small query: ```SELECT utm_source, count(*) FROM leads WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-14' GROUP BY utm_source;```

mike: I saw the ad server change earlier this week — click URL passthrough got trimmed, looks like utm_medium and utm_campaign sometimes dropped. Pinging adops.

jen: Also noticed the webinar signup form had the AB test hidden field we pushed last night. Could be an extra redirect param that breaks some click routing. Rolling back that test now.

sam: For the attribution debate: we should re-run both 7-day and 28-day windows before we call this a conversion issue. Delayed conversions could explain pipeline > GA.

olga: Can we add a dashboard card showing GA vs SFDC parity at the account level? Right now the dashboard only shows aggregated counts, which hides source-level drift.

elaine: Action list by EOD: 1) rollback (jen) 2) re-run attribution windows (sam) 3) ad partner passthrough check (mike) 4) add parity widget (olga). I'll book a 20m standup at 3pm to align.

mike: pinging @adops and @partners. Adops confirmed they'll push a passthrough fix in the next ad-server deploy :thumbsup:.

analytics-bot: Re-run complete. Temp snapshot: - GA->SFDC mismatch = 24% leads missing utm tags; - 7d window undercounts by ~14% vs 28d. Full CSV: https://redwood-insights/weekly/22345/csv

jen: Rollback done. Monitoring form submissions — already seeing +3 signups in the last 30m :eyes:.

sam: Re-run results pushed to dashboard and exported to shared drive: #marketing-shared/weekly/flightdeck. I also attached the 28-day attribution CSV.

olga: Parity widget added to draft dashboard and shared in Console. It shows GA vs SFDC by utm_source and account. Feedback welcome.

elaine: Nice. We'll note this in the weekly KPI email as: "temporary tracking regression corrected; adjusted attribution window to 28d for webinar cohort." Add that phrasing to the KPI note? @mike @jen

mike: Yep — add a short line about partner redirect change and mitigation timeline.

jen: Adding a line about AB test rollback and short-term monitoring plan.

analytics-bot: Final metrics snapshot saved: post-fix recovery to -4% WoW (was -28%). Saved report: https://redwood-insights/reports/22345-final.

sam: Recommend an automated parity alert when GA vs SFDC drift >10% for any major source. Prevents surprise swings.

elaine: Agreed. Sam — can you propose alert thresholds and a short runbook in the ticket? I'll slot "dash parity alerts" into roadmap.

olga: Will do. Thanks all — great quick turnaround.
